Shell.promise: Your bills are never used to train AI models and can be deleted at any time.

Home.title: Think your hospital bill is wrong? Check it in minutes.
Home.subtitle: Unbundle finds duplicate charges, unbundled procedures, and prices far above Medicare, then explains each one in plain language.

upload.title: Upload
upload.body: Add a photo or file of your bill. We read the line items for you.

review.title: Review
review.body: Check what we read and fix anything that looks off.

letter.title: Get your letter
letter.body: See what is worth asking about, with a letter you can take to the billing office.

checks.title: What we check
checks.intro: Every check follows a fixed, public rule. Here is what we look for.

duplicates.title: Duplicate charges
duplicates.body: The same service billed more than once on the same day.

math.title: Math errors
math.body: Units times price that does not match the amount charged.

dates.title: Wrong dates
dates.body: Charges dated outside the time you were actually there.

unbundling.title: Unbundling
unbundling.body: Parts of one procedure billed separately when they should be billed together.

quantity.title: Quantity limits
quantity.body: More units billed than Medicare allows for a single visit.

outliers.title: Price outliers
outliers.body: Prices far above what Medicare pays for the same service.

vague.title: Vague charges
vague.body: Lump-sum or unlabeled charges that do not say what they were for.

denied.title: Denied, then billed
denied.body: Insurance denied a service, but you were billed the full amount.

trust.title: Findings come from public Medicare rules, not from AI guessing.
trust.subtitle: AI only reads your bill.
trust.body: A fixed set of checks built on public Medicare rules decides what gets flagged. The AI never decides what is wrong. It turns your bill into text and, afterward, explains the findings in plain words.

privacy.training: Your bills are never used to train AI models.
privacy.delete: You can delete your bills at any time.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: We could not load this page. Please try again in a moment.

NotFound.title: We could not find that page
NotFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

Review.title: Review your bill
Review.subtitle: Check what we read from your bill and fix anything that looks wrong. Rows we were less sure about are highlighted.
Review.needsAttention: {count, plural, one {# row needs a closer look} other {# rows need a closer look}}
Review.allClear: No rows need a closer look

errors.units: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
errors.modifiers: Use two-character modifiers separated by commas, like 59, 25.

source.title: Original bill
source.description: The part of your bill each row came from will appear here.

Review.empty: No line items were found on this bill.
